    power[i] = power[i - 1] * 10

bucket = [[] for _ in range(10)]

    tmp = ((c1 - x) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1
    sumArr[depth] = (sumArr[depth] + tmp) % MOD2
    bucket[depth].append(tmp)

    for d in range(10):

    if x > n:

    if (x + 1) * 1000000 <= n + 1 and x * 10000000 > n:

        c2 += c1

        start_digit = 0 if x != 0 else 1
        for i in range(start_digit, 10):
